facebook.caption: This place fixes burnout. Chùa Hùng Long sits on the edge of Phu Quoc, far from the beach bars and resort noise. 4.5 stars. 104 reviews. Almost no tourists. Walk in, slow down, breathe. The incense, the silence, the sea wind. Some places just reset you. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Stepping inside Chùa Hùng Long and the noise just stops. No crowds, no vendors. Just incense smoke, golden light, and the sound of wind off the water. This is the Phu Quoc most people never find.
